values.note: Full-service 30-amp site C$65.10 a night, tax included (Campspot shows it as C$50 plus a C$6 admin fee a night plus GST). Tent sites: 15-amp C$25, no power C$20. Monthly RV rate C$975 + GST, subject to availability.

note: Town of Drayton Valley RV park (6001 44 Ave) beside the Omniplex, ball diamonds and Western Canada's largest pump track, with the town pool and waterslide next door and the Drayton Valley Museum on site. On-site caretaker; showers are free. Pets on leash, with an off-leash dog park nearby. --Claude
